summary: A 1969 note making two suggestions for reducing congestion at hosts that swap programs in and out of memory. One is to let the host control the order in which the IMP delivers messages, so it does not waste time swapping a user out and in. It is a proposal, not a standard.

eli5.summary: A busy teacher can only talk to one student at a time. This note suggests letting the teacher choose who to hear next so there is less shuffling around.

questions: reduce congestion at swap bound nodes
